capabilities.description: Lets beekeepers register apiaries and hives (only the owner may add a hive), then list and look them up along with each hive's current status.
capabilities.name: Apiary and hive registration

capabilities.description: Records and validates hive inspections, and flags a hive as needing varroa treatment when an inspection is above the threshold. The flag stays until a treatment is recorded and a later inspection comes in at or below the threshold.
capabilities.name: Hive inspection and varroa health monitoring

capabilities.description: Keeps a catalogue of treatment products and records treatments given to hives. Honey harvests are recorded only when the treatment withdrawal period is respected, and each hive's treatment and harvest history can be looked up.
capabilities.name: Hive treatment and honey harvest tracking with withdrawal-period enforcement

capabilities.description: Links scales to hives and stores their weight readings. A swarm is detected from the weight data and a delayed SMS alert is sent; recording an inspection that explains the weight change cancels the pending alert.
capabilities.name: Hive weight monitoring and swarm alerting

capabilities.description: Builds quarterly reports with hive counts and varroa-flagged hives for each region, plus honey harvest totals for the quarter.
capabilities.name: Quarterly regional beekeeping reporting
